required_checks: Reconcile NEMO serving-cell RSRP semantics with OAI ss_rsrp_dbm, including SSB/reference-signal power definitions.
Audit gNB transmit power, RFsim rsrp_offset_db, antenna/cable gains, UE calibration, and any scanner-versus-connected-UE offsets.
Verify whether positive ploss values are physically and operationally valid in the deployed RFsim control path.
If a justified constant measurement offset is found, apply it as an explicit measurement-equivalence transform and rerun the frozen existing bank before requesting POWDER time.
gate_before_next_reservation.reason: The best state supports the UPV SINR interval but its median RFsim RSRP remains 9.75 dB below the UPV calibration median; all eight candidates miss the UPV RSRP interval in the same direction.

post_audit_conditional_design.if_measurement_offset_is_resolved: Rerun Phase 2 first; do not collect new executions unless the harmonized target overlaps the current bank.
post_audit_conditional_design.if_positive_ploss_is_not_valid: Treat the RSRP gap as a reference-power/discrepancy-model problem; do not force it through ploss calibration.
